issues.description: patch_description uses a hyphen separator after the sequence number: '0001-Bump cmake_minimum_required...'. Rule CS-12 states 'patch_description 用空格分隔（非连字符）' — description words must be space-separated, not hyphen-separated. The example format is '0001 build aux config.guess' (all spaces).
issues.fix_suggestion: Change patch_description from '0001-Bump cmake_minimum_required from 3.1 to 3.5 (CMake 4.x dropped support for < 3.5)' to '0001 Bump cmake_minimum_required from 3.1 to 3.5 (CMake 4.x dropped support for < 3.5)' (replace hyphen after 0001 with a space).

issues.description: version field is not quoted. CS-14 example format shows version: "1.3.1" with double quotes. Current value 'version: 3.11.2' is unquoted. While YAML parses this as a string (multiple dots prevent float interpretation), the rule example explicitly uses quotes for consistency and safety.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'version: 3.11.2' to 'version: "3.11.2"' to match the CS-14 standard format.

issues.description: Field name 'software' does not match the standard format. CS-14 example uses 'name: zlib' as the field name for the package name. The current manifest uses 'software: nlohmann-json' instead.
issues.fix_suggestion: Rename the field from 'software:' to 'name:' to match the CS-14 standard format (example: name: zlib).

issues.description: Stale template placeholder section '### 对话 #N — 2026-04-26 HH:MM' remains in the file with unfilled Chinese placeholder text (e.g., '（做了什么，如"执行 configure"、"修复 xxx bug"、"制作预编译包"）'). This is leftover template content that should have been removed or filled in before submission. CS-5 prohibits residual template placeholders in submitted code.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the template placeholder section (### 对话 #N — 2026-04-26 HH:MM and its placeholder content) since actual conversation #1 is already filled in below it.

issues.description: Stale patch status in the source modification table: '补丁状态' column says '待生成补丁' (patch to be generated), but the patch file patches/0001-CMakeLists.txt.patch already exists and is included in the PR. This is inconsistent and misleading.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the patch status from '待生成补丁' to '已生成' (generated) or '已完成' (completed) to reflect the actual state.

issues.description: assertion_count is 8 but test_package/test.cpp contains 9 assert() calls (3 in Test 1, 2 in Test 2, 3 in Test 3, 1 in Test 4). The MANIFEST.yml comment labels this as '近似值' (approximate), but an off-by-one discrepancy should be corrected for accuracy.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update assertion_count from 8 to 9 to match the actual number of assert() calls in test.cpp.
